findings.seen: The photographs show the athlete with thick, red-brown hair pulled back into a high ponytail. She wears a wide, cream-white fabric headband across the front of her head in all four images, and she has no fringe.
The athlete has a lean, athletic build with broad shoulders and visible muscle definition in her arms, particularly noticeable in the training photograph.

In the match photograph, the athlete wears a charcoal sleeveless V-neck jersey with darker charcoal diagonal stripes on the side panels. An orange fox head crest in a dark hexagon is centered on the chest, with a large white number 22 outlined in black centered directly below it. A small white maker's mark is visible on the upper left chest. There are no sleeves, shoulder pads, player name, club name, or sponsor visible.
In the match photograph, the athlete wears a charcoal lacrosse kilt with a small white maker's mark on the right hem and a small orange fox crest on the left hem.
The athlete's feet and ankles are cut off or out of frame in all of the photographs, so her socks cannot be seen.
The athlete's feet are not visible in any of the photographs.

In the match photograph, the athlete wears protective goggles with a black frame, dark wire cage bars, and a grey strap with printed branding. She holds a lacrosse stick with a grey shaft wrapped in off-white grip tape. She is not wearing a helmet or gloves. A lacrosse ball is not visible in any of the images.
In the match photograph, the club crest is centered high on the chest, directly above the number 22 and below the V-neck collar, measuring about a hand's width across.
